text: Sure, it's free to play, but you'll definitely need to pay to progress. After a few months of playing and spending way too much in the game, I'm again stuck at a point where I can't progress in the game unless I spend, AGAIN. The more you spend, the more difficult the levels. There are too few "freebies" to help you finally get past hurdles. Such a shame, because the game is pretty entertaining *when* you can actually play. I'll be deleting after the current team event. I'm done wasting money.

It used to be a lot more fun but now most of the levels are difficult (or extremely difficult) even when it's supposed to be a regular challenge. It is heavily skewed to push for players to spend money. Coins earned for clearing a level average about 50. It costs 900 to keep trying a failed level without restarting, so the rewards are paltry at best.

It's fine, plenty of challenge (a level might take a week to beat, or even longer, unless you're willing to spend in-game currency on continues and power-ups). The only thing that truly upsets me is that the "refill lives for coins" option is hidden under the quit option, so if I click through the quit button too quickly, it charges me in-game currency *I did not want to spend* to refill lives *I did not want to use*. It's the only part of the game that truly feels scammy and exploitative.

Fun! No wifi needed. The main match 3 game is fun, and having a few side game options keeps things interesting. Many match 3 games are too challenging, and you end up frustrated because you have to spend all your resources just simply trying to get through the levels. This game isn't like that. (So far. I'm level 386). My only criticism is that I wish the room decorating part was more interactive. Like giving choices of different decor to use.

Meh. It was fun. Puzzle 1-800 and easy and fun enough. After puzzle 800 they all get a bit more challenging. After puzzl3 1000, good luck. I had a 793 puzzle winning streak from puzzle 1-800. Now I'm lucky to be able to win 1 maybe 2 puzzle a day. Some days I'm stuck on a puzzle for days. I don't spent money on games. Not much fun when you can't beat a puzzle for days. Was looking for a game to pass my down time, not stress me out.

The game punishes you for not spending money after awhile. I run a clan with another teammate, we're in the higher levels of the game, and all of the optional games for little power ups and cosmetic items have all of a sudden become near impossible to get. The only members of our team to get them are the ones who pay for the pass. If you pair with those players, suddenly you can easily win on those games, but will be near impossible with anyone else. We're about to uninstall.

I am getting more and more frustrated with this game. If I close the game, with or without moves left, no matter if I open it back up immediately or take a little bit to open it back up, it always starts my level over. Leaving me losing all my rockets, tnt barrels, and super balls along with the number of plays I had left. So I have to start at zero and recollect 10 balls to get my super ball back.

something has changed. I don't know if it's new management, but it is not good like it used to be. now the money hungry management has made it so you waste your power-ups and coins faster so you can buy more more-often. newsflash, people will always spend money on it. I figured it out quickly, so when I run out of power-ups, I will delete the game. it's unfortunate too, because it used to be the best game on the play store. if I recognize a better change before I run out, I'll keep it.

I loved playing in the beginning. But now I realize it's just a money grab. maybe I have been foolish this whole time thinking it was straight up. However, whenever I start to build some momentum, it thwarts it with several difficult puzzles requiring I use all my tokens and special items. Way too many times, I have been left with one item to clear. The damn propeller always goes after the wrong thing, misaligning other things I have previously set up. The fix is in. I will never pay for it!

I'm over level 12,000. There was a time when the game was fun, especially with the team I led. However, gameplay is constantly interrupted by numerous simultaneous mini games. It is now inundated with tasks and progress feedbacks to the point that it's no longer enjoyable (app is 1.7 GB & growing). All these interruptions feel like pop-ups. You also can't complete card sets without spending money. Like others have said, you can be one card away from completion for a month and still not get it.

This was once fun, and it certainly does have a community factor in the groups, which is a positive. However, game play changed dramatically and it became exceedingly difficult to make it through a round without paying ridiculous amounts--which often aren't honored. As a result, I uninstalled it, though I imagine they won't miss the money much.

I appreciate the fact that the developers spent time on the sound effects, for me the little things count! THe game obviously gets more difficult the higher you get but if you don't allow yourself to get overwhelmed you can figure out where to attack to win. My favorite part is rescuing the King. It's timed so there's some pressure but just concentrate where you need to go and you can always bounce between goals to catch the best moves. Now, if I could take my own advice!! It's a great game!

not fun when you're not winning. there's no ads, so that's nice; lots of competition, but the higher the level the less you win, and when you're out of lives, it takes half an hour to wait for another life. I've been on the same game without moving forward for 3 days now, and this happens more often than not. it doesn't help to use boosters, it seems to annoy the algorithm and creates too many wasted moves. UNINSTALLING

This game is fun when I can actually play. Some of the levels are so hard, almost impossible to beat, that it becomes more frustrating than fun. I am considering deleting this app. Also, many of the screenshots shown on the advertisement are not really how this game is, they are false. I uninstalled this and Royal Kingdom. it became too difficult and frustrating to beat levels without purchasing help. it's not fun anymore.

Good time passer, though only briefly. I started playing this game last spring or summer - it was great. Team play was amazing and it was easy to win side games and complete sets and tasks. It was easy to veg out and play for an hour or so. These things are nearly impossible now. You rarely hit a win streak, and can never keep your Super Light Ball more than 2 levels. If you complete all your tasks or sets, you're either extremely lucky or have paid a good amount of money. AVOID OR DELETE!

the game is fun until you start to notice that every time you win the light ball, or you have a chance at earning something cool, the game all of the sudden becomes super impossible even though they list it as an easy level. And the way the colors drop you see that you're going to get a 5 in a row, but no, you only get 3 away before the colors finish dropping.

The ads that show saving the king are not what the game really is as that feature only happens occasionally so that's misleading. What it really is is a certain number of moves to complete each level by matching the jewels. About one in four levels are impossible to complete without having to spend money. You just always run out of moves and it then offers options to continue for more money.

Definitely a Gacha matching game. Levels do start easy, hard then very hard throughout. After a bit it requires you to spend money for in game powers or to give yourself a few more moves to use to keep your butler buffs (because it's not enough) After spending a week on just 1 level, I'm done with it entirely. Majority of the matching boards are randomly generated and never helps the player. No matter what tactics you use, it is a different each time with what to match first and what falls next.

This game has become trash and unplayable. The creators are going to push themselves out of the market because of greed. The levels have become too difficult. It's started as a fun way to relax game to being too difficult to play so you can buy moves to move to the next round. Some levels can literally take you days to finish or until you get fed up and decide to pay to move on. The whole idea for the programming, Spend more money, make us richer..

You will automatically win games when you first install it. A hard level may be accomplished after 5 or 6 rounds. Then, the levels will become ridiculously hard to win. You will start getting less moves as the levels become harder. Not much fun to play, so don't waste your time downloading it. (OAN?) When I deleted this game? Several months later? It was automatically downloaded back on my phone 🤔 Now I'm wondering if these people are "Hacker" 😡

started the game when it was much more playable. now it's rigged to the core to force you to spend resources nearly every level. To give you perspective on how it became obviously rigged. 1. shooters combo shoots in wrong direction about 75% of the time. 2. generates bombs frequently to screw your combo build up. 3. it randomly opens with sudden pop-up ad that if you accidentally press, 9900 gold will be gone for some double point trash deal. 4. the power-up rewards are no longer permenant.

waste, don't spend your money, it's built for you to spend too move forward. I pay regularly for the app but for the card event, they rarely give me the full 135 cards, before the event ends. I played it and got a set only once,. I'm on the 6th one, I spend too much to not win the card game. at least on time, damn its about 60 days...... and yet they don't give you all them.... they responded to me that they couldn't do much, I have the screen shot.

Can be a lot of fun. However, it requires that you constantly need to buy coins in order to win.. The algorithms are sometimes not real friendly. Some levels cannot be won without buying coins. If you choose not to keep dumping money, it could take 15-20 lives before they let you win. since you get a life every 30 minutes, I have played on one level an entire day.

You know, this rating used to be 5 stars. This was an amazing game to simply wind down at the end of a long day. But some kind of recent update has upped the difficulty to 11. After personally playing 13,000 levels? Only NOW has it become virtually impossible to play without purchasing power ups. I will now fail a level 6 or 7 times in a row before moving up to the next level. Then the process repeats. You'll get your 5 stars back when you return this to casual play and not pay to play.

I've been playing for years. Just casual playing. Hit level 1000 tonight and thought... it's a good time to leave a review! I love how easy it is to play this game. I'm a senior (69) and when I have to wait for something, appt, a table, etc... This game opens in seconds, play is quick, no internet, no annoying ads (there are ads, just not horribly annoying ads!), I personally don't spend money but you can if you want to! At level 1000 and I still enjoy it. Definitely a 10 out of 10!

ready to delete this game. I'm on level 10,988! I've been playing for a long time. every level at this point is hard or as they have now Extremely Hard. it's hard to advance to the next level plus no one will give you help with an extra life. NO ONE! I think it's because no one plays it any more. Royal Kingdom is better. This has become too tiring. playing for days with no next level in sight. Bye Bye! FTS!

I like the game but there is a flaw with the double board levels. Example you try to combine light ball with tnt it will not do it 50% of the time. instead the light ball will choose a color. this happens on my table or on my phone. I don't know if the programmers did this on purpose. I would like to see this fixed but there is no support button in the app. hopefully they read their reviews.

Unfair rewards in Puzzle Match. Step 2 is a 9 piece puzzle, while step 9 is a 36 piece puzzle and the "reward" given for completing both steps is exactly the same, a single measly light ball booster. They took away the 2x booster from Butler's Gift, they now want you to pay for it! Rewards continue to decrease while you have to play more to get the smaller rewards. The developers keep finding ways to make this game more unfair and a total waste of your time. Total money grab, do not even bother.

when Im in a game and run out of moves. I need to transfer funds to buy extra moves. I'll leave the app open during the transfer and when I go back I'm at the main menu. I've spent sooo much money on this app for that. you guys seriously need to fix that bug because it's really not worth playing if that's going to continue happening

This game is just pure fun. A simple preimse that kills time. The colors are bright and relaxing. The game doesn't require too much thinking which is great. The nightmare levels are fun and give you a good challenge. I highly recommend this game. This is a casual game so if you want a more challenging game go somewhere else but this game is great for everyone.

No lie it's ADDICTIVE and PLAY at your own risk!!! At first I came for the game board that they displayed in the commercials. I was disappointed when they never really matched what was displayed. As I continued to play and joined a team then it became a different experience. Then when I created a team that works together the experience evolved even more!

I wish I could give them minus stars. I'm so sick of playing the same level for 5 days or more. I'm way up near level 4,000 & I've tried every scenario to beat the level & I don't have any implements to use. The game has made me extremely mad & I'm not sure if I want to keep playing it unless the the developer reaches out to me. It used to be that you could ask them if there's a way to beat the level & you don't get that. I flat refuse to waste money on a game, too. 😡

It starts off great, but later game difficulty gets a little ridiculous. There's an objective to each level and a limited amount of moves are allowed. I've reached a point where 20 moves is all I get to take out 127 objects with limited space. Not sure how to beat levels like that without paying or waiting weeks on end.

Level 10339!!!!! Since the last update to the game in June, 2026: things have gotten weird. It tells me I've got a free 30 minute play but nothing transpires. I'm just so glad that I've never paid real money. The EXTREMELY HARD levels are STILL slowing the gameplay down to a crawl! All in all, the whole freaking game has gotten very difficult to enjoy anymore.

fun game until you get to the higher levels then you can't catch a break. You don't get anything to work with and it's impossible to earn anything. You just end up losing everything and then play the next level 30-50 times . You finally get bast it and the next level states extremely hard. Just greed they want you to spend money.

Amazing game! Match 3 is so addicting, and getting to build a castle with it is great! The gimmicks? En pointe! I just wish it could be played without WiFi. Edit: so, now it's offline again! Before you couldn't do any events offline - not a single one! - and now it's been reversed back to the way it was. Much better, Dream Games!

Although this is a free game it does lock you out of advancing if you run out of lives unless you have enough coins to continue. You can buy more coins with real money or wait for a while for your lives to fill back up. You can replay levels if you have coins otherwise there are penalties to replay the levels such as a losing a lot of your power ups. You can buy power ups with real money. So, similar to all games, they count on micro transactions which is why I only gave it 3 stars.

A sinister ripoff of Candy Crush. Lures you in until you've played maybe 5 rounds, then increases the difficulty to take your lives. If you don't play for a few days, the difficulty drops until you're back and playing again. The game seems to be setup to intentionally create addiction. I noticed it would play in my mind after I played for a few days, causing me to see the stupid shapes when I'd close my eyes or try to think about other things I need to do in life. The terms follow this issue.

I wish I could give this 5 stars. It would be so fun and addictive but instead it's just frustrating because so many of the levels require extra moves to beat, which you have to buy. It would be fine if a few here and there were too hard to beat without extra moves and power ups, but it's nearly all so it really just takes the fun out of it. I'm probably going to delete soon and find another easier match game.

Seems like the more $'s I put into this game the more it jerks Me over. In several ways. I'm about ready to delete this game. If it wasn't for My teammates I would have deleted it a ling time ago. This is the 1st game I have ever gotten on a team. Also put thousands into it. After Design Home started Me over erasing years of playing and $'s spent all gone and totally ignored after several emails asking for help. These games seem to be just huge scams... Not enough enjoyment for the $'s spent.

Once you get to harder levels, you play the main game unsuccessfully for about 5 minutes and then lives are gone. Without winning the main game, you don't have whats needed to play the side games, which were fun when I actually got a chance to play. Without winning the main game, you also lose the chance to win coins and helpers, like bombs, propellers etc., so you can't win without the help , but you can't get the helps without winning. Same for the double mirror ball.

When I first started playing this game, it was fun and creative. Now, it is boring, really, really boring. Why, you ask? Just like all the other reviews, it changed into cash to play. They effectively reduced all the bonuses and added "Extremely Hard," which has the same payout as the "super hard" used to. Do not play this game unless you have lots of cash to pay to play. Even an average level. Boooo Royal Match. You are what's wrong with the world.. .greed

update 05/04/26 thank you for bringing back the Royal Pass! vs the weekly. back to 5 ⭐! Too costly with the weekly pass. This game is highly addictive and lots of fun to play. however they've gone from a $9.99 monthly pass which we could use our $5 off coupon for, to $7.99 a week! of course that's optional but if you want to advance in levels you're going to have to pay. I don't know that I'm going to be able to continue this game.

If you collect a lot of coins, the game will try to make you spend them by making the puzzles almost impossible. If you still choose not to spend them to continue the puzzle or to buy new lives, it will just take them. I had well over 27,000 coins last night, and today, I have 17,000. I haven't made any erroneous purchases. It just stole them. Horrible Game!

It's fun for a while. The algorithm seems to really favor some players over others. For instance, I'll join the daily "competition" with players at the same level. I will fail the level for hours. The person I played against beat the level so soundly they managed to get 30000 points to my 500 and failing. This is a regular occurrence. "Super hard" means stuck for days. "Regular" means you may or may not get past it in a day. Obstacles become tedious instead of fun. It's a mediocre game.

Champion's Clash is a scam. They want you to try as hard as possible to win the Grand Final and use your power-ups against bots so you have to buy more (I'm not spending money on this game). No other complaints. I'm sure they'll eventually make the levels too hard to beat without buying power-ups, but that's nothing new with pay-to-win games. I'm around lvl 550 and still have been able to progress, so at least it's fun for now 🤷‍♂️ That being said, every pay-to-win game is getting a 1⭐ from me.

This game is great! It runs snappy even on an old phone, and the "mium" to its "freemium" isn't particularly intrusive or annoying. It really doesn't run ads unless you want some bonus items/lives or something. The level designs are clever and fun to play. The one thing I'd keep in mind is that I personally like games with cooldowns, so ymmv. Though the cooldowns aren't too bad, they only come up when you lose a level enough to run out of lives.

I hate how everything in this game is expensive. Like for example, why do you need to spend 900 coins on only 5 moves when you can hardly get money in the game? I especially hate how levels that are supposedly not labeled a hard level, have very little moves like they expect you to finish it on first try. I constantly kept losing lives doing this. This game having no ads is one thing I like.

BEWARE: This is a predatory game that is designed to force you into spending real money in order to progress. Countless times, I'm one step away from completing a level. I have to spend 900 gold in order to get five additional steps (when only one more step is needed). The game is programmed to get you close enough to completing the level, but one step shy. This has happened several times now. It's a pattern that I recognize. Once the challenge I'm in is completed for this game, I'll uninstall.

I have been playing this game for more than 3 years(in royal league) and Royal Kingdom for a year and I never spent any money until this past year. As soon as I did, the $1.99 and $2.99 purchase options suddenly became $14.99 and $19.99! That is absolutely ridiculous!!! The purchase prices should never change just bc you spend some money. The cost should stay the same for everyone no matter what!! If anything, the price should decrease if you are willing to make purchases. Total predator move!!!

I use to love this game. It was so much fun! It had some challenging levels, but mainly was just easy and fun. Now there are WAY too many hard, super hard and extremely hard levels. Now the levels are WAY TOO HARD. Its not even fun anymore. I wish I could leave no stars and still write this review. Make it easier again. It's not fun when every level takes multiple multiple tries

Royal Match. It claims to be the exact game they advertise to be, Save the King. From the rockpile, fire, snake. That's the game I was looking for. Sure, the game is ad free and wifi free, just like it says. But it's not a save the king from the rockpile type game like it looks on some of the ads. It's basically Bejeweled, Candycrush with mini games. which is fun enough, but they run out of steam, that's why some of the ads show other gameplay. mislead

The game is fun if you have a chance of winning. As soon as you do a hundred levels or so the game becomes predatory. You will come across levels that are legitimately impossible without perfect drops. I swear it sometimes tries to misread inputs so ylthat you make moves you don't want to. the game is fun, I dont deny that. but when I get stonewalled at a level because I ran out of the basically mandatory power ups it ceases to be fun.

This game is trash, just like Royal Kingdom and anything associated. I had 70 rockets, 110 bombs, 87 specials and 40,000 coins that randomly disappeared. I also randomly lost my butlers gift and super special streak as well. This game is a scam and if I could rate it lower, I would MOST definitely do so. The only way to get far in the game, is if you pay out of pocket. This game has nothing to do with skill and would HIGHLY recommend not downloading it; it's not even worth it.

I had this game rated at 5 stars, and it is fun, but it seems like lately that to beat levels, you have to increasingly buy packages. I dont mind to spend money occasionally, but if you spend some money, the developers need to give you a bone and not make gameplay so difficult just to get you to buy again. i have quit purchasing packages and if I win, I win. if it continues to be very difficult to move on the levels, I will uninstall. too many other game choices that doesn't nickel and dime you

I used to love this game. They have made changes that make it much less fun. The special pieces no longer explode in the optimal spot. the 2x lasts for shorter time. You have to get more and more cards/ coins/ levels to reach the same rewards or worse rewards. it's still fun to play, but if you're not willing to spend a lot of money, you're going to get frustrated.

I hate that I keep coming back to play this game. Unfortunately, it's true. The higher you go up in the game the more impossible the levels are to beat. It doesn't matter how many power ups you use, if you have the special disco ball thing, you'll lose it all as soon as you have it. Then, suddenly, after the 20th time of trying, everything magically works out. I tested it also and purchased one of their 99 cent offers & sure enough won 10 consecutive games. But lost it all after.

Beware! Designed to make addicted and spend money!! If you spend money on this game or even if you don't, and you have racked up a ton of coins, the game will become rigged to the point that you will lose 100,00 coins to keep your red mines because it just doesn't want you to win after a certain point. Same with buying. if you stop buying for a long time, it just stops giving you anything good in the game (like no matches) & stops displaying good deals for more coins.

In the beginning things start out fine with the game , but once at the point of doing well in all regards it will cheat you out of everything that was gained in process by taking your achievements away ; making you start from scratch and try in effort of working your way back up to the high points . Unlike a various other games it doesn't give out much on an everyday basis . Though , it may be an alright game to pass the time ; I wouldn't recommend it to anyone .

I've been playing for a long time. They recently added a Multiplier Token that you can purchase. Royal King is deceptive and has the token purchase pop up while you're entering a level. I clicked on it not realizing what it was. No confirmation. It almost wiped out all my coins. Support has been gutted as well. No one to email for refunds. If you can't find the answer to your question in support, you're out of luck.

I have been playing this game for years. I have completed over 11000 levels. The game used to be very generous with its rewards and I loved that there were no ads. lately the game has made the levels so impossible to beat without a massive amount of power ups. I had over 100000 coins and it depleted me down to 17000. The levels have frankly become unfair and the joy of playing this game has passed. I'll wait for my coins to hit zero and then I'm done.

once your get up to about level 100, the game is nearly impossible to win on the first attempt. it costs to many coins to buy power ups or 5 more moves, and you win only a few coins on each level. to many items need to too SEVEN his before they are cleared, and there are multiple different items of these on each level. no ads, but a frustrating game unless you want to keep paying to play.

It was fun, until I reached level 159. After trying for at least 2 weeks (maybe more - I've lost count), it looks like the only way I can win is to pay for boosters. Well, I don't pay for boosters, so after writing this review I am uninstalling this app. I play another game that occasionally I get hung up for a week or so, but eventually the algorithm changes, and I'm able to beat the level without paying for boosters. I'm very disappointed in this game.

It's a decent match 3 game. It beats candy crush in some ways as the AI *usually* makes better decisions to clear pieces with on-the-board power ups. As you get higher up, the game will force you to use special items and spend coins as levels can't be beaten without them due to the way the game is programmed. There are no ads, but the difficulty to do event challenges (diamond cards, etc.) has become insane, in a blatant effort to get people to spend money.

It should be an fun game, but unlike other games I play, there are not enough prizes to maintain the games. Once 5 lives are gone, too bad. Can't get enough coins to continue playing, and I refuse to buy things to continue to play. Too frustrating and a losing battle. I heard great things about this game, but am disappointed and will be uninstalling it

Liked it a lot better in the beginning. Wanted a game that was an easy distraction to turn my brain off. It was easy & relaxing in the beginning. but later levels are sometimes frustrating & make me turn game off. so don't love it. March 2026 edit. I am now at level 615 it is labeled super hard. I am not interested in super hard levels. so will be deleting this game soon. don't download. It is so annoying to have to delete a game you've invested time in. But this was supposed to be a distraction

I used to love this game for mindless killing of time, as there are truly no ads anywhere. But over the past few months they've consistently made small changes to make it harder and harder to specifically continue streaks and it feels like a blatant play to get people to pay to play, along with adding what amounts to popups for some levels. I don't mind supporting a good game but no way am I paying as much as they ask for most of the time. I'm right on the edge of permanently deleting the game.

Game was pretty good but lately seeing an increase on the cost of things. For example, 100 x2 multipliers used to cost 9900 gold but now 9900 gold only gives you 50 x2 multipliers. Considering the game doesn't allow you to win a decent amount of gold (only a few events), making that change to the multipliers is crazy. It's enough to make me start thinking of uninstalling the game.

Player beware! Once you get to 10 k plus boards, they make it almost impossible to move forward without buying assistance. I play games for enjoyment and relaxation. This is no longer one of those games. It is not fun to try multiple times to move forward and gain a power ball because they take it as soon as you achieve it. We play games to relax and escape daily stressors. This is no longer that game.

I have been playing quite awhile and have noticed the game has clamped down on winning. I am pretty conservative when playing but still have lost over 80,000 coins in under 2 weeks. I have also noticed they have taken away the bonus rounds after every 100 levels cleared, now it's every 1000. No loyalty and I would give this game no stars if I could. I used to enjoy playing but not so anymore. At this point I only play because of my team.

it may be a fine game for these sliding puzzles but dang this type of game is boring, like watch paint dry biting, they're all the same, some have TNT, some have spinners, some have both or any combination of special items but ultimately they're the same dang game. I wish someone could really put some unique twists on one to make it unique and fun. Maybe spend less on TV advertising and more on design might help. Boring, repetitive, played this if you've played ANY slider puzzle in this genre

Hi. Just had to let you know a couple of things before I stop playing this game and delete my account. I really love this game...it's fun and challenging, and I'm pretty good at playing however I used to ve able to play and beat even the harder levels and not have to spend money after money after more money just to lose it all extremely quickly only to have to spend some more money just to try to beat the levels that you guys have made way to difficult to beat without spending a fortune .

I've foolishly spent a fortune on the microtransactions in this game. it's fun, highly addictive, but programmed to always leave you one move short on just about every level. also, that "super lightning ball," is a GUARANTEE you're going to lose the next level without spending. If you've either got: A - money to burn, or B - zero cares about gameplay outside of the individual levels, it's a refreshing game in that there really are no ads. But it's a complete rip-off otherwise.

Great game, I just wish it didn't take up so much space. I think it stores locally all the decorations from every single scene you complete, so the memory usage just keeps creeping higher. Wish there was a way to discard that since I never once have gone back and look at a completed area and would just as happily discard that data as storage on my device is at a premium.

I've played this game for a couple years and at first it was very fun. The lower levels are easily done and of course as you progress you'd expect the levels to increase in difficulty. Im pass levels 13500 and the levels have become impossible to get through. The royal league levels are the worst to get pass. Dont be in a rush to get to the royal league levels, you're stuck in those for days waiting for them to time out just to go back to a regular new area to complete.

I've been playing this game for quite a few years now, but am starting to get fed up with it. I've noticed with the last few updates, the boosters are not nearly as helpful as they used to be, and when it comes to the dragon or train partnerships, the levels become increasingly more difficult to beat; I've gotten to the point that even with great partners, I'm unable to complete them without spending money (which is probably the creator's strategy to begin with).

The popup boxes need to stop! I was about to push a button to start a round and then something immediately pops up and I accidentally click it and spend 9k tokens! I'm not even sure what it was. 9k tokens wasted and robbed from me!! Same with the try again buttons between levels. Now it takes forever and forces you to use all your hard earned rewards and moves that would normally clear the board, such as the power ball crossed with a propeller, fall short so you have to use additional items. Fun is game for a while until you have completed all the areas. Then, it's impossible to continue without buying extremely expensive boosters or coins. The game seems to be rigged, as even when you have cleared the field of any objects, if you don't buy anything, one or two objects will remain on the field and force you to buy more moves if you want to advance. Waste of time, scam, and no different than Candy Crush. Don't bother with this game.

game doesn't match the ads. It's so annoying. No, 95% of this game are not whats shown in the adverts that are so ubiquitous currently. Worse though, the game is clearly setup to make you spend money and is not skill based at all. You will progress well though the early levels, but once you hit 150 or so, things will start to crawl and you will find you are constantly losing with the occasional 'miraculous' win coming if you struggle long enough so the game can keep your interest. If you are prone to spending on online games beware!

Nice and fun up to level ~200 when it becomes a money grabbing machine. You burn through your powerups and lives and even then you cannot beat some levels without retrying multiple times. I reached 222, retried that level for 4-5 sessions burning through lives with no luck, so uninstall and so long. I can gladly pay for some games when I feel that the game is fair, not the case here, definitely. Oh, and spare me with the canned reply "our developers are constantly working to grab your wallet!"

Now disappointing. Have played this game for about 2 years and it used to be fun. Some challenging levels but you got through them. Recent updates have shown that the prizes have been reduced for completing missions, card collections, and all the other extra mini-missions you have to do. The game on a whole has become so difficult to pass levels that the only way is to spend money to get power-ups and coins. Used to be a favourite. not anymore.

The game starts out really well. Challenging levels mixed with some easier ones. A few thousand levels in, and it gets to the point where you can not proceed without purchasing stuff. At that point, it becomes tiresome, and one looks for alternative games in the same genre. Some advice for the developers... let those who want to pay do so. Just don't force others who actually like and refer your game to go elsewhere because it gets boring after 30 or 40 attempts to pass a level.

I installed the game especially for King's Nightmare levels. However; those levels are not as introduced in the ads. In the ads, the King moves forward as you match boxes and you can reveal heroes to help fight monsters chasing you, you can solve pipeline puzzles, etc. The actual game levels are about only matching tiles within a given time frame. There is no King's movement, no surprises, no chasing monsters, no heroes revealed, no different puzzles. It is another game different than its ads.

I have been playing this game for over a year. I do enjoy it as it was not a rip off. Now its just the same as all the other money grabbing games. They have changed the algorithms to make the game much harder than it should be. 9 times out of ten you could clear it buying only 5 extra lives. now its more than 10 moves or more. Using gold each time which you pay for. Hardly any gold and even less boosters are available. Frankly I'm stopping playing now. So your greed has lost you a customer.

Was a great game. Was the best match three game there is. Level 217? What's with level 217? Can't get past it unless you pay. I'm assuming it only goes downhill from there. Edit: Don't waste your time! In the months since my last review I've managed to get to level 223. Not fun and a severe waste off time. Weird, greed I guess. More irritation than game!

A good game, but designed in the way where you either wait 140+ minutes to have 5 attempts on progressing a difficult level, or you pay the money, and increase your chances, no guarantee that you will succeed. A lot of games do that nowadays, but I'm just tired seeing an AD of this game. I thought at first all you do is rescue the king, and with the amount of ads I saw, I honestly wanted to fail on purpose. This game was advertised as "This game has no ads!". In other words, lots of P2W stuff.

I had to edit this review. I gave it 5* after like three levels of playing, but I had to downgrade. There are a few things you should know if you want to enjoy this game. I got this game app when I saw the ad on my sudoku app. The ad was the King's Nightmare. But the King's Nightmare is nothing like the ad. Also, the game is fun & addictive, but some levels are very tricky, & the timing of getting lives back encourage you to spend money to get by some blocks. You can join a team, but too hard.

My experience is similar to the others. I am not interested in paying to play, which is pretty much a requirement once you get to the higher levels. Happy to pay a proper fee ONCE to install a game and maybe see an ad after each level, but not whatever they are doing in this game. Not fun having to replay the same level dozens of times.. Uninstalling.

Been playing it for a couple of years. Level 11000+. Used to be fun and exciting. That has gone out of the window. Algorithms are absolutely rigged. Doesn't need a scientist to figure out that game is trying to force you to spend money. Sometimes even the simplest of levels won't finish until you retry 2 or sometimes 3 times. Earning coins has always been incredibly hard. 900 for the first retry was too much. Now rewards have diminished and it's all about $$$ sadly.

Game is great, but is set up so you can only go so far and then have to spend huge amounts ov money to progress. I spent £10 a few times and it was gone in minutes. Games should be able to be bought outright for a fair price not this deceitful model of getting you hooked on them, then making you pay obscene amounts to continue on the game

This used to be a terrific game....truly cost and ad free with decent value add-ons if you wanted to make faster progress. But they've increased the difficulty so much recently that it's virtually impossible to make progress without paying. I've completed over 12,000 levels, so I don't think it's because I'm rubbish! No fun now. Don't get into it.

Same frustrations as others. Once you get to higher levels it can take many, many attempts to pass the level. Have had levels numerous times where only one more item to clear and no more moves. I will not pay to play any game, so I guess I will be stuck on the same level for days upon days. More super hard levels than Kings nightmare or bonus levels.

Only gave this 2 stars instead of 1 because graphics are great, the match part is fun, addictive and gives you satisfying visuals when you get the power ups. But it's nothing like the ad. The game is fun and very satisfying but higly addictive. I had to remove it for my own good because I started to spend more money than I was planning to. It's a nice game with good graphics. Really enjoyed it until a point where you're basically forced to buy powerups/addons if you want to progress. I regret ever downloading the game after seeing the ad about it where you would be required to save the king from some sort of danger, but in the game there is nothing of such. Okay, so once you get over a certain level, the games become repetitive. I got to level 415....yes I'm that sad....it just goes on and on forever with no end. Otherwise, there are far better match 3 games out there. Move along.

I downloaded this game, and enjoyed it for a long time, but once you get to a certain point, it's not possible to win levels without either a) spending your whole life playing, or b) spending loads of money. The game started off easy and fun, then it started to get harder from around level 235, which is ridiculous. Not like the ads. The levels shown on the adverts haven't actually appeared in the game. I'm now on level 925 (not a new player) and still haven't seen the advertised levels. Game is really fun and addictive, but the developers purposely make it so some levels are impossible to beat for a certain amount of tries in an attempt to get you to spend money on extra lives and power ups. Doesn't work like it's advertised, with mini-games. Game isn't offline either, as advertised, when you reach Garden you have to log onto internet to download. enjoyed playing this at the start. now it takes days to complete a level unless you spend money (i refuse to do this). Like most games of this type, fun initially, then it rapidly becomes so hard that you spend days (or lots of money which I won't do) to progress. Don't bother, it will drain your bank account. Some players get unfair advantage of double points. Not level and you have to pay to get through lots of levels. It starts off as enjoyable but then gets stupid hard really quickly. 900 coins to get 5 extra moves is far too many as winning a level may not even get you 100 coins. As other have said, what you see advertised is not what you get to play. Poorly scripted game, you know what I mean if you've played enough . probably one of the most frustrating games I've played, was sailing through the levels and was stuck on the same level for three weeks..... paid 99p to get some more coins, conveniently I cleared that level immediately they've got me now I guess I'll have to buy more gold to move forward. Very boring. I don't require a story to play a game. I play games that require a lot of concentration. Adding a story doesn't make the game itself any more interesting. For one, the game was advertised differently from what i experienced. disappointing! The game use to be so enjoyable. It's a really addictive game, lovely graphics and just enjoyable to play, however, there is always an however, it may be ad free, but some levels are so hard its impossible to pass them without paying for more moves, I mean £1.99 for 1000 coins and 900 of them needed for 5 moves and moving forward it will cost another 1900 coins for another 5 moves, ouch thats expensive and thats why this game has no Ads! I have got into the trap of paying for more moves, I'm sad to say. dont download!

I love this game. But I'm going to moan about the extra life minutes and extra weapons helps we may randomly get for half an hour. I have no choice whether to accept. This game lied. I installed it, as it looked fun. That was the first lie. Advertising no ads, in the game, was the second lie. For me there is too much going on in this game. I like my games to be relaxing, this game is opposite. It bombards you. No story to give you time for thought. While this game does not match the ad, it is a pretty fun and varied match3 game with unique elements. Joining or starting an active team is very helpful, as you can ask for (and grant) free extra lives. If you get stuck, keep trying; sometimes levels take 10 or 20 attempts before you get a lucky draw. Take advantage of infinite lives on Mondays. I usually get through the 50 new levels (every two weeks) in a week witheut using any power-ups. Don't give up!

My only complaint is that sometimes the animations take more time than I like. not typically a big deal, but if you accumulate 1000 stars, it'll take considerable time to get through them.

I'm tired of this game. I'm stuck on 'Hard Level' 372 and it's beginning to irritate me. The only reason it's hard is because you don't get enough moves to succeed. The powerups fall into areas away from where they have no impact whatsoever, and some of the objects have to be hit 3 or 4 times to remove them. 27 moves is simply not enough. The only way you eventually win is when the cunning algorithm senses you're not going to spend any money and therefore it lets you win, finally. Had enough.

Therapeutic Game... The only game I've played the most in my life... I love it so much.. I also love that my progress is saved... I recently reset my phone and I was worried about starting from level 1,only to find the "Save progress" button.... I'm currently over level 720.. I love love love everything about this game. It's for keeps and a must have.

You have to make enough hits, with inadequate amount of ammunition! You have to play a level x amount of times to complete it, its so frustrating at times. The developers should revamp the game, based on users feedback! Imagine, you pay for the game, then it literally robs you bare face and the developers think, that the game is bug free!

If the whole game was kings nightmares that would be awesome. It is as advertised, but only every one in a while do you get them. The music is fine at first but after a while the music is just annoying. I also like how you can play through the entire game for free and nonstop. And only pay for stuff if you want to.

5 stars just cause it has no ads in game. It's a good game, basic match the colors game. I'm on level 2700 and I've only lost about 20 levels, 1 just cause I wanted to see what happens if you lose a level. I don't find it challenging and I've never spent a cent on this game. Not much like what's described on the ads but it's pretty entertaining. Every blue moon you play a save the king level but they're few and far between, like every 50 or 100 levels or so.

I give only three stars because even though I enjoy the game it is almost impossible to pass so e levels without spending money. And when you clear a level you get the same amount of rewards. It should be more as you get higher. It just gets you annoyed after a while that you are getting higher and higher but you still get the same amount of rewards. Update. Here I am still playing hoping to see better rewards for getting higher and spending so much money! And.... nothing. You still get the same

True to their word no ads .The games you see in ad are mini games .It's a match three and beyond puzzle .Animations are cute. Plenty of events .Coins and power ups are easy to get .Difficulty is moderate .No need to pay to enjoy this game . Available offline. Needs internet every few 100 levels to download next level.Unparalleled. The best. Download it NOW.

IT'S ABOUT TIME!!!!!! Finally, a game with NO ads!!!! And game play IS as shown when you watch ads while you play other games. (It's actually the minigame, but is still in line with the match-3 theme.) The graphics are cute, music is catchy, solve engaging puzzles to decorate different areas, and I have been playing for 3 hours, as rewards are generous. My only suggestion is to be able to "undo" a move for coins.

I downloaded this game for credits in MistPlay, and I fell in love. This game is easy to play, making it perfect for all ages. The animations are nice and smooth, and the use of powerups is fun and satisfying. There are no ads. The ads for the game are a bit off - it's a match-3 style game, not a block game, but the game is more enjoyable than I thought it would be.

I really enjoy this game, so much so that I've made it over 2000 levels and am still playing. No ads, not overly greedy and loads of fun. I deducted one star due to the fact in game it states you get 25 tokens for duplicate cards and although I've gotten several duplicate gold cards it only gives 5 tokens no matter the card and it takes absolutely forever to obtain a wild card. Other than that, outstanding job.

Loved it, then it got to the point that you can't play without paying. I beat over 7000 levels and enjoyed it, around levels 7260, every single level was so difficult I was stuck on it for days. It became boring, frustrating and repetitive. It's ok to have a hard level, there were plenty. But to put super difficult levels one after the other with no respite and seriously no way to win unless you buy extra levels or power ups just made me quit the game. I'm sad and I hope they fix it.

Like so many others have said, the problem with this game is it is absolutely impossible to keep advancing without spending money. You would think after so many complaints, they would change it a little. They're just after your money and know they can get new players. Wish I had half of what I spent back. Never again!

I don't know what going on? But I noticed the price raise that is way out of control. Not enough options like they use to have. $6.99, $19.99 deal are gone They been promoting that $44.99 deal. If I can't see better options in about week I have no choice but to look towards others games. I like this game it's fun. Already spending $9.99 for the season pass then another $6.99 or more for the week. But when I start seeing $44.99 as a start when I'm use to spend $6.99 or $9.99.

I didn't download this game for a long time. I figured the ads were just teasers like a lot of others and the game would be totally different. I finally downloaded it a couple of days ago and I love it! I don't understand the complaints about the levels getting to hard to solve. You are given ample opportunity to gather bombs etc. And a good game does get progressively more difficult. You don't have to spend money to play, no ads, no wifi necessary. 5 stars from me.

Rigged so you have to spend real money. At first it was fun to play but as you get higher levels you can't beat them without spending money on power up items. This is intentional and the developers know it. But those with addictive personalities will wind up spending too much money trying to beat just one level.

SMALL HINT AT END: I'd given the game 5*s. Then 4* cause they took away the super spinner without notice to force a download of the update. Now? 3*s. I love this game & my team, but I'm being put with players 200+ levels above me in tourneys! I lose! Pass some levels & you can pick from tons of teams til you get a good one. Mine is "Judd", but any good team will help refill your lives. Every seven days there is a "sale". ALWAYS click on it! The 1st three items are FREE! Hope that helps :+)

This game was good in the beginning, but it became hard, like very hard which is impossible to finish. I have been playing a level for two days and still can't pass it.Why is it like this??? May be just to make money..so you can't finish a level,buy more moves or booms.YlThis is called cheating.And above all,you cant report any mistakes done by the programmer. This is why I am giving it only one star.

This games sucks. It's just a different kind of Candy Crush. The advertisements made it seem cool but it is nothing like the advertisements that you are forced to watch while playing other games. I downloaded it expecting to have to save the King from calamity but after like 10 levels never even got the chance to, instant uninstall.

Edit: months later I'm still playing, I'm on level 1543(!) and never had to spend money to advance. Sure, some levels are so difficult, it gets extremely frustrating to keep repeating it over and over and over again. But, I'm a patient person 😌 Also, join a team. Any team. You can request lives from team members, and don't have to pay for it in any way. And you get 5 coins each time you give a life.

It's as good as any other swipe match game. I gave it a 2 star because I'm tired of games advertising something they don't actually do. You don't save the king from mortal danger which I thought would be a fun challenge. You just earn stars to build a castle which I don't have any interest in. Can everyone just do what they put in the ad?? How hard can it be!

I downloaded this just to leave a negative review because of your annoying ads. They take up so much time! Everytime you click to get past them, it's some stupid game, or just another page with an extremely small "x" to press which is so small, it OBVIOUSLY misses and opens up the stupid page to download your app. I hope whomever is responsible for your ads, gets herpes. If I could leave a zero stars, I would.

New edit, I've given the star back, I've actully found where you can save the king lol, since that was my beef to begin with. Great game - No Ad's ever - and you can play without pay - I've done it. I enjoy this game, pass' the time when needed. Collect your points and keep on going. Thanks to the creator, very enjoyable, and did I say No ads!

The thing about puzzle games of this sort is that at a certain point in the game, you will be enticed or forced to purchase to carry on. I think I have fallen victim to this, so have decided to stop playing entirely. No fault with the developer, but this is definitely not suitable for those who prefer 100% free play.

I enjoy the game, I also enjoy competing w/other players! I don't like the game makes it impossible to win until I've spent cash, I do spend cash, but that's not enough, I continuously pay cash, to have a chance to get to the next level! I don't have $ to pay for this supposedly FREE GAME! It's extremely expensive for me! I get caught up, and before I know it, I've spent way too much money! The only left is to quit the game all together, & find a less expensive game

I only download the app for 1 reason, to give it a honest review. It's NOTHING like the ads. It's like any other match game, easy, boring and repetitive. I played it for 10 minutes and it was the same thing over and over. The ads seem like it's saving the king when really it's saving the king almost NEVER (with the 10 minutes I didn't get to save the king, it was all building his stupid castle) So either fix the ads or I will report the game for false advertising cause it's NOT saveing the king

This game is nothing but another Fishdom. Another match 3 game, that does not allow enuff moves, to clear a board & move on. Instead, ur stuck on the same level, doing the same thing over & over, like an endless loop. Personally, this makes no sense. I'd give this game 1/2star, if it were possible. I just deleted it.

As others have said, it's fun at first, then becomes impossible to beat the levels. What good is lightning rush or any other race against the clock type of game against other players if it takes 50 tries to beat one level. It's stupid to me. There are literally thousands of other games available to try. I'll find something better.

It's fun to play. I like the game though challenging to win at times. However, 900 coins is a lot to give for five more games. I had two games left and bought five more which should have been seven but only five registered. I have also bought the Royal package and other packages. Since it is pay to play involved and no real gifts, I give it a three.

Your never going to win the tournaments unless you spend real money. The game is very addictive and at the same time very frustrating because the way it's programmed to allow an extra five moves for 900 coin's which takes several levels to save up unless you pay real money to buy. Just wish there was a way to save life time as often, I don't want to play for 2 or 3 hrs in one go. Always waiting for the new levels evey 2 weeks 10m downloads so they must be doing something right. Download and try

I love this game but it is WAY too expensive!! I've played other games for years and have not spent as much as I have with this game. You gotta spend 900 coins to get 5 chances to beat a difficult level then your prize is not near the 900 you spent. At this point it's not worth trying to level up so I will be playing with what I have and not spend anymore money. Not sure what the developers had in mind but it definitely was not keeping players excited to play.

I had been playing this game over a year. Made it over level 4000. Then it started crashing, taking up all the memory on my device and would not loaf after the last update. Thinking it was my older device I reset that and restarted all of my apps losing all of my status and returning to level one. However, it turns out that when I re installed this game It was actual just this game. It still freezes, crashes or just won't start. Great update! Now I will be deleting your game

It's a money grabber. If you manage to max out and complete all levels, the levels become so ridiculously difficult that you pretty much have to spend money in the game to move on. All in all, it's a fun, addictive game. The game runs smoothly and is brilliantly designed but, the developers are cashing in on this one for sure. Play at your own risk, and if you start feeling like you have to spend money to win, uninstall immediately or you will go broke.

Loved the game but not any longer and I've uninstalled it . I just couldn't beat a higher level. You only get 5 lives. I'm not spending money. I'm not bumming for lives. In response to another review, the FB was levels can be beat. I disagree. I have a job and a life. I just want a fun game that I can play in the evenings and/or weekends. I don't have hours to spend on this game.

If you want to play the same level over and over and over...this is the game for you! Update: I decided to delete the game. It would be fun to play the game and move through the levels, but you really have to play some levels for days, and I finally got sick of it. If you ask for help, it will involve giving more money. Some of the people that help out on levels with free play time, but some refuse to help and only want money. Sad

My complaint about this game isn't the usual - you get enough coins per level to keep it interesting. I got to level 2000 before packing it in. Why? The game is buggy, that's why. There's a specific match target to get specific power-ups, but when I meet them, I either don't get the proper power-up, or sometimes none at all. But the worst offender was one stage - I finished the stage on the final move, but it said that I failed. Nope. It's broken, and I won't play a broken game.

Overall a good game, but the later levels are too difficult. Yes, you can beat levels without boosters or coins but that requires a lot of luck, and you will end up with 0 lives and nothing to help fast. I suggest making boosters easier to get early on or maybe have one free booster for watching an ad. Optional, but helpful. Plus ad money is easy money but it's not in the player's face. It's a win/win.

This game is so much fun. One of the best 3 solve puzzles games. However, you only have a finite of time to play for free. The problem, is that I will receive 30 min or more to play with free lives but I'm unavailable. When I am available, I don't have enough lives. If you could charge something reasonable like $4.99 to play whenever, I will happily sign up. I want to play but with the current pricing structure it doesn't make any sense.

I'm really enjoying this game. I like that there isn't a scoring system, just goals to achieve and there is a lot of opportunity to get free lives. My only complaints are that some of the levels are clearly reused with tiny changes and the advertised levels aren't really in the game. I'm passed 1000 and I've maybe had 2 or 3 King related levels. Not sure how far you have to go to get the ones in the adds, but it seems like a lot.

Great game, but definitely set up to make you spend money. Totally rigged on every level. Almost every game ends with only one move left to make for the win, but it will cost you 900 coins to continue. And when you do pay and have a lot of coins in the bank, you won't win again until they are all gone. Then, just like magic, you win. Total rip off if you pay for anything. You are better off not paying and gettin the same redults.

I gave this game my very best, but alas it just wasn't satisfactory. It possesses some redeeming qualities like having no ads, but that isn't enough to save it from what is essentially 50% based on luck. And when I become stuck simply because the game decides to not give me what I need to progress without becoming a pay to win, it no longer becomes fun. I'm sorry, but i cannot recommend this game to anyone else. 😔

This game is no better than Candy Crush. It advertises saving the King but I'm on level 34 and all its been is clearing the level to furnish the Castle. If the adverts aren't lies, I would suspect it takes you to level 100 before you get to the levels of saving the King as advertised. I think it's all a lie. The only good thing is there isn't any ads at all, so not like ur interrupted every 2 mins with ads. Still a fun game but not as advertised.

I've played many Match 3 games, but none compare to this. Unlike most its centered around powerups and items but in such a way that you almost will always have what you need, making it much more fun than a game like Candy Crush. The constant stream of rewards helps keep you going just enough to beat the level. Almost every new gimmick feels unique no matter how similar it actually is. Even if/when the gimmick isn't the greatest, the theming is on point.

it is a cute fun game so far! I will rate more later. The royal match ad needs to be shortened instead of thinking you are done and 2 more ads of it! I understand ads make you money, but they are becoming a lot longer and more. I love the game and money still. I still give it a five star...it's fun!!!

1% player strategy, 99% game controlled fate, you cannot win unless the game allows you to win... You will need power ups to finish the most difficult levels, if the game does not give you the power ups you will need to buy them (real world cash, not game cash). I got stuck for two days at the level 219, because I'm not willing to spend money I rather delete the game...

Every single ad is a 100% false. There is not 1 single level that represents the levels shown in ads. I'm on level 1931 and have never had one any way. It's a decent game and there's no ads. That's why I like it. Wish the levels were more interesting as advertised. I'd give it 5 stars if the ads were accurate.

DON'T believe the ads! The ads portray the game to where you have to clear the pieces (sort of like candy crush) to save the king, and that's it. NOPE. Just a few mini games, then you have to do tasks (like homescapes) that I have no interest in doing. Fastest game uninstall ever!

So, this is a fun game until you hit level 1000. You are better off playing Castle Crush. Then, you basically have to pay for upgrades & use the extras/upgrades to even win a game. I have been stuck on the same level now for a week. There is also times where I open up a treasure chest that will show I'm getting large amounts of premium currency & then not get that amount. Overall, it is a fun game. But, they make you pay for it.

I got about 15 hours in the game now. In terms of gameplay, i give this a 4/5 stars. Simple, fun and addictive. I give it a 5/5 tho because there are NO ADS! Almost all mobile games have ads every 2 minutes and its a huge turnoff. I've pretty much uninstalled every game that has ads cus it ruins the fun and flow of the game. I appreciate the game devs for focusing on the players having fun rather than being greedy and selling out for advertiser's money.

4th time trying to post a review on this game without it being deleted. The game is definitely pay for luck/pay to play. It pits you up against other people (supposedly), and puts a fake sense of urgency to the game so that you'll pay money to beat more levels than them. The levels themselves are "COMPLETELY" beatable with enough tries and a perfect round, but it's always easier to use power-ups to beat these impossible levels, am I right?

I like to play this game alot but....I have spent far too much money on this site than any other site EVER and the algorithm knows this and it plays to spend data it atrocious!!! You need to be fair in the rewards to the amount of coins collected and the gold spent. It basically doesn't let you progress unless you spend.

This game is really fun, it might not be exactly what the ads say but it is a lot of fun, it doesn't force you to use power ups it gives you free ones that show you how to use it then keep all the ones that it gave you it us amazing after clearing, or building, an area it gives you power ups and gold so it is useful to do so so you can continue to play the fun game that it is. A bonus round comes up that is like the ads that you play and they are a lot of fun. And there are no repetitive ads. :)

This game is very misleading in my view. Not really free unless you want to stay stuck at a level for days on end. Very difficult to get ahead to higher levels without paying. Don't waste your time. Deleted it once I realized the farther you get, the more often you pay. A big thumbs down! 👎

I love the game so far! The graphics are beautiful and the noises aren't annoying. (They have updated to an additional game of save the king) and the levels can be challenging in the game but nothing you can't beat. I am almost on level 100 and have not yet seen an ad nor had to buy anything so it is doable! I love the bonus coin levels! Also, it is easy to gain extra coins and boosters! The only thing I recommend is maybe adding 2 stars for harder levels or when you save the king getting 2 star

This is a fun and quick moving game. I think the graphics are great. Right now I'm dealing with a bit of a glitch. One of the main reward icons isn't showing and or giving my rewards. One of the main parts of the game is to win pieces to add to a room at the castle. But another glitch for me now is I cannot go back and review all the rooms I have decorated while playing the game. I do still like playing it a lot.

This game is what everyone says- fun but costly. It is impossible to win without money after a certain level is reached. I still played (and paid) until multiple times a week, I was having technical issues- game closing randomly, levels freezing & starting over for no reason causing me to waste power ups & money over game errors repeatedly. The final straw was reaching out to tech support over my issues and being ignored and brushed off. Avoid at all costs, it isn't worth the frustration.

It's ok, a little unfriendly on the penalties, which is how they make money. It is definitely not relaxing, as the ads claim, and this genre is so overdone that it is surprising that people still play it. Once you've played one, you've played them all. The trick is not to alienate your customer base, as this one starts to do early. One star removed for this Thanks for letting me try. Tell the old man in the ad to stop lying to ppl. I hate ads that don't represent the game, another star removed.

Love this game, I've made it to level 451ish. I've never spent real cash to beat any levels. Sometimes I get stumped on levels. It does seem like if your on a level for a long time that it tries to help you by giving you bigger matches.. and there are times that it gives you unlimited lives for 30 mins to a hour, or 30 to 15 mins of free specials to start the levels. I havent any ad's either. The only thing that sucks is when you run out of lives.

What a con. Looks great in the adverts, fun challenges and all but how dull, you have play loads of boring levels, which are just random clicks to get rid of stuff and then occasionally a decent level appears, like you're expecting. Misleading adverts and a load of rubbish. Heaven knows how it gets 4 stars!

Tbh, super boring. I've yet to catch ads or glitches like some reviews mention, but it's nothing like the ads of the game make it out to be. Once every maybe 15 levels I'm guessing, you get a puzzle like it shows in the ads. Otherwise it's just a match 3 game. I'd suggest offering customization options with decorating at the absolute least. Uninstalling due to false advertising, boring gameplay, and to make space for better games, like Cat Snack Bar, which has a super cute Halloween event rn.

It's an algorithm disguised as a game. There's no strategy or skill once you get to the higher levels. You either pay to win or you go through the designated amount of "fails" until it lets you pass. Also the advertising is very deceptive. Those are "Kings Nightmare" levels in the ads and they aren't nearly as elaborate or animated in game as advertised. Feels like Electronic Arts should have made this app. Scam.

Don't waste your time and MONEY, cause that's exactly what it will take to beat the higher levels. It's not a game. It's algorithm is strategically set up to let you win or make you lose. Most games are obviously created to make money and that's OK. But to create a game and make it to where you have to spend money to beat it, takes the fun out of it to say the least. Worst game ever made. It's developed to make money period!

False advertisement! I hate that 😡 Not what you expect, a boring puzzle game. Nothing like what is shown in the advertisement of saving the king with playing puzzles. That is more exciting than building a castle by buying stars feom plating a puzzle. The same thing like the other games, boring. Stop showing this if it isn't the game.

Interesting game. But the higher you go up in levels, it gets more difficult. In most of the levels it's hard to finish within the limited moves and if you want extra moves, for the first 5 extra moves it's 900, the next 5 it's 1900... It goes on........ I played upto level 297 and I'm uninstalling as I don't like a game with limited moves to play

I used to love this game and have been playing for 2 years. Even though some levels could take a while to get through, it was still playable. Just recently though they introduced a thing where every time you fail they offer you more and more moves if you pay, whereas it used to just stay at 5 extra moves. That's fair enough but each level is now impossible to pass without paying for extra moves. You can't even get close to passing. It's taken all the fun out of it and I feel like a cash cow

If you love Pay to win games this is the game for you! The game looks great with lovely animations. But at the heart of the game is incredibly difficult levels that you need to throw money at in order to win. Thankfully I realized that before I could waste money on this game. I am giving it one star for the visuals. Reached level 241 before uninstalling

Generally I like this game. However the money hungry developers recently decided that the Kings Nightmare feature should be changed. It used to show up every day, if you beat the level in the time allotted you would get 15 min of free play plus 15 min of a booster. This really helped if you were stuck on a hard or super hard level. Now the devs made Kings Nightmare random and you get a whopping 50 coins for beating it. Pretty soon, you will have to pay them for the privilege of playing.

I use to really like this game, now it's becoming too tedious to play it takes to long to get to the next level and there's always hard or very hard levels back to back, when you have that hour you should at least be able to beat two levels I spend the whole hour trying to beat the too many hard levels, thats why I gave it three stars deleting after this review

I HATE this gamete! The ads show the fun levels, but those are far and few between. some levels are very hard to pass and the game demands you purchase things to pass the level. Not a free game! HATE this stupid game and the CONSTANT Ads! If it was a fun game they wouldn't cram it down everyone's throat, Beware you WILL be forced to pay!

UPDATE: I went ahead and uninstalled it. I reached out to both games' customer service. They give you the run around. Then, had the nerve to close my ticket because I didn't get RIGHT back to them after waiting DAYS for them to respond. Installed this game as a task on an offer wall to get diamonds for another game. For whatever reason, it's not registering as being installed on my device. Therefore, I can't complete the task. I will uninstall if it doesn't register soon.

Once you get into it, it seems fun but the more you play the "harder" the levels get meaning they want you to spend money on a match-3 game for powerups. Ads are also misleading and annoying where they show a king in danger or is about to get hurt or die. There is no dying king or any time trial like shown in the ads, just a match 3 game like any other that wants you to spend the more you play

Royal match is very disappointing because the commercials is not the same as the gameplay and I don't think showing failed ads is smart(my opinion) I downloaded and deleted the game. I don't think it's smart to show a section of the game that a user could pass but decide not to just to show consequences of a loss and not a win when it doesn't even equal the real gameplay. False advertising has many definitions and this one shows alot. It would be different if it was difficult or continuous.

Very fun addictive game. Some will not receive some of the game functions. I noticed my boyfriend gets the mission pursuit, and I've never got it! I'm the one who told him to download the game. So just be prepared because some might not get all the fun extra stuff that comes with the game. I'm so upset with this game now. I've been playing for years and have spent a lot. Do better royal match, and everyone should get it, not just some.

This game and one of its similarly named cousins somehow managed to automatically install on both of my android devices, circumventing all confirmations, checks, etc. I've no idea how, given the first time I've visited the store page is to write this statement. Clearly something very dodgy about the way the developers operate. Couldn't care less about the game itself, I uninstalled it immediately, as I would any other application that acts like malware.

While this game has no ads, the app's hyperagressive ad campaign is borderline fraud and harassment. The ad service this app uses to advertise is just short of malware, and the game, while similar to the ads, does not contain enough similarities to the ads to make me want to play. I literally only installed this app to let you know that this app has made me angrier than any other from the harassing ads alone. I will not play and will uninstall after posting this.

Was fun, was going to give 5 stars, not only do they give you power ups, you keep earning them through the game. But you give way too little coins when it cost so much to keep going. I have ended a stage with 20 moves & earned less than 75 coins. other match 3 games have given thousands. I am willing to pay here & there but not when I keep running out. Not going to pay to keep playing. Unless you fix the coin shortage, am uninstalling. And you cannot win every level without help!

it's OK, passes the time when waiting for the bus, or during ad breaks on TV. basically a cheaper looking rehash of garden scapes etc, lacking the same quality in terms of graphical content, music BUT...so far no attempts to make me spend real cash, no intrusive ads, just plays freely, and this is to be commended.

This game is a very good example of its type - great animations, decent tournaments (although no narrative). Gripes: 1) By the time it starts taking 100 levels to finish an area, all levels are "Super Hard" difficulty and the difficulty labels don't mean much. This demoralizes players. 2) King's Nightmare levels are clearly an afterthought put in to make the ads less of a bait-and-switch. I recommend making the final level before any end-of-area bonus level a "King's Nightmare" boss puzzle.

Skill is irrelevant in this game. The outcome of each level is predetermined. And there is absolute inconsistencies when a level is labeled 'hard' or 'super hard'. The game allows me to consistently win in 3 or 4 attempts when it's labeled a 'super hard' level, yet will eat up all 20 of my lives on a level that is supposed to be normal difficulty? Why bother labeling then? It's all about luck, not skill. Think of it as a slot machine... play long enough, and you'll eventually hit. 😕

I'm not happy with the last update. I was at level 9000, now I don't get the free coin level at every 100. I'm forced to play the group game for days. I've accumulated almost 600 levels, no coin levels and it doesn't count as how many levels I've gone up. I would have reached 10,000 but doesn't count. Not fair I hate that I'm forced to update every time these new level games are finished. I want my normal every 100 level rewards!!! I'm about ready to delete this app.

Ok up until they just want money from you. Games are fun at the beginning but then they make them impossible to pass unless you buy extra moves at £3 or more. Entertaining simple game that I enjoy. There are in-app purchases available, but they are NOT needed to enjoy this game. Also, I'd recommend joining a team to get help with more lives (don't need to bug your real friends on Facebook! Lol). This game is most similar to Candy Crush (difference is Royal Match feels like there are many more features to help a player).
