I've played and spent a lot of time and money on this game. And in retrospect, I realize it's not worth either. Your rewards aren't inlign with levels, and you don't get much for what you pay. I am deleting and encouraging others to do the same. Sure, it's fun, but I can play alot of other games for a whole lot less money and more benefits.

The first thousand levels are fun, but then every second level is a hard or mega hard, and you end up playing the same level about 20+ times. Loads of more levels to go but the fun has been sucked out of it now. Also a lot now people moaning about the same thing but the review score staying high. Not suss at all 🤔

This is one of only 2 games on my phone. I usually download games and delete them within a week or two.. Love it. The graphics and the sound effects are awesome. Extra life after completing a room or after completing 5 levels would be nice. Thanks for not having any pop up ads!

In terms of mobile games, this is probably one of the best. Yes, it's another match-3, but it makes up for it in ad-free gameplay and generous rewards. It seems to have a fair difficulty curve for at least 200 levels. Ads for it may not be representative of the gameplay, but given how common such tactics are, I can look past it and see the fine game behind it. It may not innovate, but the art is charming and suggests some passion. This offers a lot of fun content without wasting your time. A+

UPDATE!! I have proof that the game developers manipulate specific accounts to reduce rewards offered for various challenges within the game. It is intentional and not random and they have admitted it. After years of play and $$$ spent, this is egregious business practices and I DO NOT RECOMMEND you download or play this game. CONSTANTLY RUNNING OUT OF LEVELS! Come on you guys.... hire some more designers and coders would ya!? 🫤

Good game with a lot of different events to enter that can help you win boosters, coins, etc. Pretty easy starting out, but aftet the first hundred or so levels, it gets tougher. Some levels are extremely difficult. The bonus levels are great: you just collect as many coins as you can, so there's no pressure. The King's Nightmare levels are the ones shown in most of the ads, & are optional. My only suggestions are to have some backstory & interaction with the characters, & daily bonuses.

So I have been playing this game for over a year now. The game is really fun. I love how it is a puzzle with save the king levels, hard levels or super hard levels as you go through the game for variety. I am over 7000 levels in and no need for money. You will need some patience to wait for more turns or join a team who can help you get more turns and coins for power ups. There are other activities where you can have unlimited turns for an hour or something. I highly recommend this game!

In August 2021 I gave a 2 star rating. REASON: I don't mind that the levels get harder. What will make me delete it is that I downloaded it because of the 'save tbe king' games which will NEVER come after level 100 according to customer service. I don't get it. I'm so glad to see that more 'save the king' games have been added. It makes an already fun game better. I'd give 5 stars if it didn't take so long to get lives. 🙂

I'm not very far into the game but so far I haven't run into any of the complaints. That I read about before downloading. However most said it became almost impossible in the much higher levels. I don't know why they don't advertise they could easily make a lot more money. I would think that they have decided to go with this system because they're doing well from it. More power to them.

Actually,I should just rate it a zero!A total waste of my time and battery!Stuck at a level which is just programmed to be impossible to pass through because they want you to spend money on coins!Very frustrating and not worth it!

The game is colorful, creative and the bgm tracks are exceptionally too good. The Nightmare is the epic part of the game because in order to save the king and to know what is the nightmare that he is having at the moment makes it more interesting and anxious. Cheers to the team.😎

Fun game like the challenge. It need to have more way to get extra moves 900 coins for five extra moves is terrible you need to be able to collect more coins especially in gameplay And save the King and collect coin challenges the rewards are terrible There needs to be better tournament to earn coins and boost also not enough moves on hard levels shouldn't have to use all your boost to pass them One great thing about this game is no ads. So all and all can't complain too much

THERE ARE NO ADS!!!! I have absolutely no problem paying for apps or games, but you obviously have to give it a go first, 99% of games you either have to pay to remove the ads, or you have to pay at some point to advance in the game. All I want to do is enjoy something when I have some spare time, at last I found this, thank you to the developers , this is more than perfect!!!!

I've seen some of the reviews about how difficult the levels are and I agree some are extremely hard and I've had to play them sometimes 20 or 30 times to beat them but that's part of the game! I think that's what makes it fun and challenging. It gets you to really think on the really super hard levels. I'm on level 2801... In the league and I don't intend to stop. I didn't know how many levels you guys were going to create but I love this game and I played it for about 6 months from level 1!

Terrible Issues with billing. I try to buy coins each time then it says cancelled. Then my receipt comes through on email, saying I've paid, but on the game?no coins added. What a rip off! Happened at least 4 times now. Please someone fix this

One of the best match games I've played! Hooks u in, and I like that you don't HAVE to pay to play..but if u want to, there are many choices! Thank you! My only issue, is there is so much going on..with the addition of the cards* that it is slightly overwhelming. I love simple. If there is a way to help with this, I would definitely be grateful!

This game is fun but it is also a frustrating money trap. The game can be fun but it seems to always end with one move left so you are enticed into spending your coins to get extra moves. Plus, you are only given so many lives. Once you have used them you have to wait on timer to let you back or spend money.

I see a lot of negative reviews of having unbeatable levels unless you spend cash. I'm on level 1601 and haven't spent any money. Yeah some levels seem to require you to use your special items. Be smart save them for times when you are really stuck on levels. Don't get frustrated and use them all cause you've tried a dozen times. It's a great game if you have patience to wait for your lives or are in a good group that help with lives several times a day.

So I downloaded this game after seeing the annoying ad where they try to unsuccessfully save this dopey looking King from various perils by matching tiles. Turns out the game is nothing like that. False bait advertising. It's basically just the Kmart version of Candy crush and nowhere near as good. Uninstalled for fake advertising.

This is an awesome match 3 game. Great contests and mini games inside of the game itself, super generous rewards compared to other games. (I'm on level 633 in Harry Potter puzzles and spells, that game is also excellent but the rewards are smaller and it is a harder game). As far as people complaining about the difficulty, no way. This game is really well balanced. Without some difficult levels it wouldn't be fun. I'm on level 203 and I haven't hit a wall that has frustrated me to death yet.

One of the better pay-to-win match 3 games. It's pretty fun to play free to begin with, as levels aren't too hard. It's also refreshing to not be bombarded with "offers" on microtransactions every time you open the game or run out of lives etc, and it has some nice polish & quality of life features (less waiting etc.). That said, it's still pay-to-win. By about level 300, it becomes more and more difficult to beat a stage without power-ups or extra lives, and prices can be staggering.

why make the game so difficult even the collections now are way to difficult, its no longer fun to play please take it to the way it was before atleast, then when you play difficult level you get some good coins not this . After tje last update you have to pay before you move to another level. dont make me stop playing my favorite game due to this irrelevant difficulties you introduced.

Was convinced by the interesting advertisement, that shown quests and more dynamic levels. It turned out to be the usual "gems matching" game, static and impossible to solve after you reach a certain level. Big disappointment, uninstalling!

The visual style and sound is very appealing, the effects are nice to watch, but the "King's Nightmare" levels which are shown in the ad for the game are quite different and you encounter them once every 8 levels or so. The ones I have seen are just normal match levels, the only difference being that they are timed. The ad showed a level where you had to do strategic matches, not frantically matching anywhere on the screen just to get enough points to win.

On level 189 and it's impossible to get through without boosters. No way am I going to spend money on stupid boosters to keep playing this game. I thought it was fun until this impossible level. Looks like it's time to delete the game. Also the game doesn't play like the adds so it's a lot of misleading promotion for it.

It was fun at first, until I figured out that this game is pure luck - no skill whatsoever. If the game decides you win, you win. I've cleared super hard levels with 20 moves left and no power ups.And I've spent hours on a normal level with full power ups, most of the time getting nowhere near the required goals.And when you explode more than one TNT barrel, it should count more than once.Meaning, if I have a board full of TNT going off, the game counts it as one explosion.Yeah, I'm done.

Very frustrating! Someone called it challenging but I call it frustrating. When you get to a higher level you cannot win until the game itself deems you can win. And I'm talking playing the same game for at LEAST five days (usually many more!) until it ALLOWS you to beat it and move on. There is no skill what so ever to win and I've used tools to no avail. I'm getting to the point of deleting it because it is no longer fun. What is the point if you end up frustrated? Games are supposed to be fun

Prefer this over candy crush. Would give it five stars but for two serious pet peeves. The biggest is the points to extend game play button placement. I've lost coins many times mistakenly pressing it when I wanted to get out of the game. The other issue is there isn't a pause button when have free play time. Once the countdown starts it's a "use or lose" scenario.

Too hard. How can I be stuck on a level for 4 days. Then a Hard level comes along so stuck for another 4 days. It is impossible to progress. Would and could be fun, but its not anymore.. Does anyone from this company actually care about the users of this app? Thank god I've never given you any money. I'd rather throw the money I do have down the toilet.

The game started great. Boosters are weaker than other games but always landed somewhere helpful. The advertised mini game is real & tournaments are plentiful. However, the game NOW seems to require money to advance. The boosters are now hit or miss on forming or landing somewhere useful. The game is still fun, but feels unscrupulous & I resent being manipulated. 3 hours of free play with all boosters free for 1 hour only to advance 3 levels until I spend money. I'll play but no more purchases.

The game keeps crashing before it can even start. When you pay for a move so ypu can win the level. It cuts off so you cant win. I've uninstalled and reinstalled it and I'm still having the same issues. It was fun while it lasted smh

I like it the most of all games I have played. It helps that there are no commercials, but it is just more pleasant and relaxing than other games. I have less hesitation about paying for levels because I feel that purchases help me advance for the most part, rather than feel like a trick to make me buy points or instruments that use up my purchase in no time flat.

Only downloaded so I can leave this review, will delete after. These repetitive and overly long ads force me to watch and listen, blocking any other media I might be playing. I freaking LOVE how this game has no ads. No add alone makes the game a five star but on top of this, it's calming and relaxing too!! Beast game EVER INVENTED!!!! (I am aware Candy Crush exists but it has ads that take away from the full experience of relaxation, so this game is far superior)

The game froze up and won't let me do anything I've been playing for a little over a week and quite a ways in on levels. But can't get the game to budge I'm gonna Uninstal and just find something else. Thanks for the fun while it lasted.

Some features favorably distinguish this game from many others in the genre. The most noticeable are no advertising, smart power-ups dealing the most possible damage, colorful graphics and high dynamics, no need to wait for the previous turn to end. But don't expect the challenging levels you might have seen in ads. It's nothing but a casual three-in-a-raw. And palace decorating? Oh come on! The real challenge is to think up anything more boring. Uninstalling and leaving a mild rate.

I have completed 1200 levels for one reason. This is nothing like the ads and I'm getting tired of games doing it. 3 levels of kings nightmare out of 1200 (including the new 100 levels) I don't mind the challenge, but this is near identical to other matching games (Toon Blast).

Going to be deleting this game. I cannot get through a level without playing it too many times and it is frustrating and getting boring. I have to use every resource I have just to move forward and many times I use them and still lose the round.

Game is very addicting, but sometimes the levels are very hard and take all day to pass. There needs to be more power ups to help complete levels. Especially when the player has attempted a level a certain amount of times.

I only downloaded it just to check that the ads were click bait like I suspected. It's probably ok as a game if you're after another candy crush but it's largely mind numbing. I'm not sure how they classify these games as puzzle games when it doesn't require much thought.

Horrible double charging and customer service sucks. Everything in this game is about selling you tools you should be able to earn. When you do make a purchase it is for a limited time forcing you to repurchase it monthly. Also, it is just okay as games go. Fishdom is way better!

Enjoyed the game initially. Difficulty went up way too fast! Got to the point where I was going to have to buy things to continue so I uninstalled. Now, since I had it downloaded before, I get constant extremely loud and obnoxious ads!

While Royal Match is a fun game to play to pass the time, it is nothing like the adds you see on other apps. You make Matches to beat the level and earn a star to build your empire. It's a decent game I just wish I were more like the advertisements that are out.

I really enjoy this game. The only thing I don't like is the fact that you have to win three games in a row to get all the butler gifts but losing one game loses all of them. You don't get extra ones if you win more then 3 games straight so how is it fair to lose all of them to one loss. I think it would be better if it took 3 losses to lose all of them.

I don't play this but I've read reviews, and it's a real pain that the ads for it pop up EVERYWHERE else I'm playing and it takes forever to get them off the screen. It must be a horrible game for them to keep flogging it constantly.

game is fun this is the second time I've downloaded the game just to start over and see how far I can get without losing but I'll be honest this profile is new my other one the game is too easy sometimes I can clear a 100 levels a day should be harder but also if I lose u guys shouldn't only off extra moves when buying stuff for instance if I have coins and lose I get 5 extra moves but if I don't have coins and lose u wanna offer 20 extra moves if I buy the coins but most time I'm only one move

Misleading game. What is advertised is a person needing help through a puzzle that needs to be solved but that's not even in the actual game. Using people's compassion n emotion to increase download numbers, whilst the game itself is a regular simple puzzle.

This is a good game but as much as the packages are & the $ I spend they sure do CHEAT me out of my $, for 48hrs I'm #1 on an event 2 mins b4 the event is over, someone has 500 more points than me & they win #1 & I don't win ANYTHING! That have a card collection spot. I had multiple collections done. Then they redid it I had none completed. They give stars for duplicate cards which they give more of then anything. Needless to say I had over 250 stars. They started a new collection and deleted all my stars so no way to save for the big chest. I will probably be deleting this game depending on the out come. Return my duplicate Stas and I change my review keep the game. Do not recommend. Stay on a level to long. Money grabbing!!

As others have said, it's fun to begin with then it takes forever to complete a level. Gets boring and repetitive doing the same level for days on end. There's plenty of opportunities to buy your way through the levels which I refuse to do.

Please add some alternative mode where player can play endlessly and without restrictions due to lives. Sometimes you just want to have a good time without stress and effort, but the career mode, due to its difficult levels and restrictions in life, prevents this

Lots of fun and doesn't have glitches like other match 3 games I have tried. I was honestly surprised how much I enjoy it. As you progress get on a active team that supports each other and you will do better. A good team will earn rewards together that benefit the entire team. Really the only negative I could give is the connectivity is sometimes off. Otherwise, great game!

Total Garbage. Came pre-installed on my phone, but because its a game thats nothing but digital sewage they advertise it constantly so I knew to remove this filth from my phone immediately. Says everything you need to know about it that is spams ads and comes pre-installed. Its digital rotting garbage. If the company doesn't like the review.. oh well I dont like seeing ads for your shovelware.

For a match 3 game it is pretty standard. It isn't a bad game.. I do feel like I spend more money than I should just to sometimes pass more difficult levels.. I gave it a 1 star . Well because I have long grown bored from match 3 games. But playing it earns me points on another app.

Well I guess it's about time for a review. This game was soooo much fun up till the last about 100 lvls. The game has become so hard that if I don't spend about $20 a day I can't really play. My advice is if you are looking to kill time for about 100hrs and for only a little money this is a good game after that don't waste it. I am very disappointed in everything this game became later in lvls. I'll be deleting it soon. Update: lvl 7700 and it's even worse don't waste your time or money

The ad was very misleading. After googling I found that the only time you get to do what's in the ad is every 100 levels and they're kings nightmare rounds. Otherwise, it's just candy crush. Waste of time and false advertising.

This is a cash grab. As you get higher up in the levels, the game intentionally gives you one move left as last move but you have no more moves to use. It the repeatedly forces you to purchase more moves to get to next left. I'm going through anxiety and depression and spent over $170 in September trying to occupy my mind. Nothing but regrets as now bills are due and I'm broke from this unplanned impact on my budget. Fun game but your wins may cost you drastically in the long run.

Really love every feature about this game. Would give it five stars if the King's Nightmares were a bit more frequent. The advertising suggests the MAIN feature of the game are these "nightmare" challenges when, in fact, you may play weeks before you get one and after a single play or two, it's over. I feel that was misleading.

Awesome, fun game! Sometimes frustrating when I can't beat levels and have no power ups or coins to help, but that's just the nature of the beast. If it was too easy it wouldn't be a great game in my opinion. It's the challenge that does it for me....and being on a team adds extra spice. To the developers: keep the updates rolling and the experience will be that much better for your audience!

Was key word " was " alot of fun until you level up. Only way to beat higher levels is with power ups. You can get stuck on the same level for multiple days. Then they run contests like the lava contest where you can win coins. Only way to beat these levels is again with power ups smdh. Ya they ran ads on TV saying it was a free to play game and it is just that. But the only way to progress is by spending money. Don't waste your time

After reading conflicting reviews, " it's exactly as the ad says or nothing like the ads" I thought I would give it a try, it's a match three I have been playing a while now and haven't come across any level that remotely resembles the ads, so I'll be getting rid of this game

I almost uninstalled this game when my freebies ran out and I got stuck on level 799, but if you stick with it, accumulate your win streak bonuses again, then strategically play only when you can gain free powerups (events every 1-3 days), you can get into a good groove where you are winning hundreds of levels first try and it feels really cool. but it's a vicious cycle of accumulating huge numbers of powerups and feeling unstoppable, then running out, failing a level, and having to start over.

Tried the game because the ads made it look interesting, but no. It's candy crush but with a king. It's what I like to call "false advertising". Maybe if you want to gain a better audience, perhaps try not to make the game look like what it's not?

This game is not fun to play - too many ads & requirements to continue playing. It's also VERY INVASIVE because it auto installs during ads while playing other games. Those 100mm downloads are surely exaggerated because of this. I wish I could forever block it but I'm stuck with uninstalling it when I find it.

I am at level 2,042. It's crazy that the reward for reaching level 2,000 was 1 hour of infinite lives and a couple of power ups. It would be great to get more moves per board played, especially with excessively difficult levels. It's going to be hard to justify continuing to play with no real incentive.

READ THIS REVIEW. Everyone always complains about having to pay to win or ads. This game has no ads. Big props. Pay to win, yes they give you pay options if you are impatient and weak minded. I've hit levels where I almost deleted the game because I thought it was stupid hard. If you can handle a challenge you will get through it. Then the next level will piss you off just as much, but you will get through it without paying. Props on a challenging game that lets you eventually win without $$$.

Finally! A game worth its salt! No lags, no glitches, no useless notifications and pop us, no false advertising, no unnecessary in-game purchasing to beat levels, and NO ADS! It's got the right amount of relaxation and timed events. I have uninstalled SO many games recently because of ads and issues. Thank you guys for finally creating a game that we can play AND enjoy!

Game is ok but it cost to much...3000 coins you would think be enough to get something but its not...on other games having 20,000 coins would be living large... on this game you would have to spend about a 100$ it cost 19,000 coins just to get a hammer if you have coins you only able to pay 900 just to get 5 extra moves which that ain't even enough because the game is made for you to pay to pass the game...

At first I loved this game, but after a while it gets to hard to win levels, the game would be nice if it would stay the same from the first play, but then the buying starts, this or that and you have to wait cause you need power, so uninstall it goes, would be nice just to buy the game out right

I really enjoy this one. But once you pass a level it's done and gone. I'm at the point that I'm waiting for new levels though. It'd be nice to be able to go back and replay some levels while I wait. Also the areas are fun and really well done but I'm not a big fan of doing the area tasks I didn't appreciate having to do 100 area tasks in order to get new levels that was not a fun few days. Please don't do THAT again.

Addictive game initially but the major drawbacks are that the levels do not seem more challenging as you progress (some require skill, others are simply won by luck), and you win around 20 coins for a game but it costs 900 coins to buy 5 lives..!You only have 5 lives at a time, and you can get up to 10 from your team. Occasionally you can win unlimited lives for 30-60 mins. I like the game but these fundamental things need addressing. It becomes frustrating.

I've played 123 levels. The are no ads and you start with 5 red hearts. Game is fun and colorful. Levels don't have enough moves. Cost 900 coins for 5 extra moves. They do offer low cost packages with coins and booster. There are lots of activities and a team you can join.

The resolution of graphics and audio is excellent. The game pieces are attractive especially the flying one. But if the game had a story in which we could build our own palace and decorate it, then I would have liked the game more and would like to keep it in my library of games.

It's literally impossible to advance past a certain point. Spending money in-app makes no difference. I was really enjoying this game til it became impossible to clear the board and get to the next level. I feel ripped off. They're happy to take your money and still leave you frustrated and unhappy. I just don't get the point.

Okay. It's fun enough as a Candy crush clone with some added elements. The problem I have is that the levels that are advertised are the time levels where you have to rescue the king. Those levels are few and far between which feels like misleading advertising to me. I'm over 200 levels in and I've only played the time levels a handful of times.

I want to be able to reset the game. I love playing but I'm on level 3000+ and it some rounds take forever to win....more than half I'd say. I just want to restart and do it all over again. It's not fun being stuck on the same level forever.

This game is a rip-off, and I am disappointed that I have wasted my time and money on this game. It was already sort of a rip off with 900 coins for extra moves, being that the rewards are so ridiculously low, now this is a blatant rip off to increase extra moves to 1500 coins still, with ridiculously low rewards and now the power plays are a rip off. Wish I could recoup all of the monies I ever spent. Also, it seems that only certain players are being targeted with the increase.

This game is fun and ad free even though it's rigged for purchases. The new update has issues where sometimes it crashes while trying to open the game and loses Bluetooth connectivity. Please fix these problems and I'll give a better rating.

This game is pretty misleading, the advertisements you see... you may only get to play like that once every week... It then tries very hard for you to do in app purchases to progress, the game becomes evey frustrating if you dont and you could find yourself stuck on the same level for a few days until you clear it. Then the worst part is, when you fail and dont want to continue, it constantly pops up screens for you to pay for extra moves with gold coins... which are useful to save to buy lives with but the game constantly tries to scam you and you find yourself many times spending coins at the end of a game to get a pitiful 5 more moves. Over all the game is just a fancy tetris with pretty graphics and music but the rest of it is just a forced cash grab, so meh

Enjoyable game, but very predatory with micropurchases. Free to play, but very limited play time is available without purchase. Purchases dont guarantee anything either since the game will squeeze you to take any coins you just purchased. Don't download it.

I got the game as I like the demos in the adverts but only get these on rare occasions which is rather misleading. I don't even know if you have to earn the King's Nightmare games because I seemed to have played at least 100 and not had one. I feel shortchanged. The other regular games are OK but a bit samey. Gave it a solid 4 stars only because I was not swarmed by ads as soon as I played through the first 20-ish levels. Completely overwhelmed by ads about this game that show very little detail about it. Like who would know that you would have to grind 20 levels to get a King's Nightmare!? Possibly could improve on the steep 900 coins that you are asked to burn every time you lose a level. Fun game until you reach level 200. After that, levels are increasingly harder and some take 100 lives to complete. I'm on 235 (Hard Level) and I've been on it for 5 days. I refuse to pay money for any app so it is frustrating to not move on.

Game is fine but the ads were excruciating. Then after a bit of playing it kept trying to force me to join a team. Then the levels became so difficult that you literally can't pass them without buying extra moves. No thanks.

Fun game, but it's always crashing when I try to play it. Every time I open the app, it freezes and continues to play the music. I have tried unistalling and reinstalling and it just keeps happening. It's really obnoxious.
